
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
source(here("simulations/linking_sim_helper.R"))
```


# sim_adult_exposure_duration

```{r}
linked_folder_path <- "simulations/sim_adult_exposure_duration/01_linked_sim"
trial_info_folder_path <- "simulations/sim_adult_exposure_duration"
unlinked_sim_folder_path <- "simulations/sim_adult_exposure_duration/00_raw_sim"
unlinked_param_info_folder_path <- "simulations/sim_adult_exposure_duration/param_info"

trial_info <- read_csv(here(trial_info_folder_path, "trial_info.csv"))
unlinked_aligned_eig <- read_csv(here(unlinked_sim_folder_path, "unlinked_aligned_eig.csv"))
unlinked_param_info_aligned_eig <- read_csv(here(unlinked_param_info_folder_path, "param_info_aligned_eig.csv"))


linked_aligned_eig <- connect_files(trial_info = trial_info, 
                                    param_info = unlinked_param_info_aligned_eig, 
                                    sim_data = unlinked_aligned_eig)



# write out the csv
write_csv(linked_aligned_eig, here(linked_folder_path, "linked_aligned_eig.csv"))
```

## sanity check 

```{r}
linked_aligned_eig %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = trial_number, y = mean_sample, color = trial_type)) + 
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_cl_boot", position = position_dodge(width = .2))+ 
  theme_few()
```
